title: Harper Oisiris Second Meeting

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Thank you for talking to me before. It's been hard to let go of the silicon weaving dream but I'm doing much better now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you for talking to me before. It's been hard to let go of the silicon weaving dream but I'm doing much better now.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Between that and the serial killer running around, I figure I've done well to last this long!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Between that and the serial killer running around, I figure I've done well to last this long!

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: It almost sounds like you want me to get sent to a scum-pit. Either way, I have no desire to make life easier for these tax-avoiding Corpsters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It almost sounds like you want me to get sent to a scum-pit. Either way, I have no desire to make life easier for these tax-avoiding Corpsters.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: The good thing about losing everything is that it really increases your chances of finding something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The good thing about losing everything is that it really increases your chances of finding something.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Avoiding my apartment, walking around. Most people die at home! Ask the Thera-Pay bots on LowTown if you don't believe me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Avoiding my apartment, walking around. Most people die at home! Ask the Thera-Pay bots on LowTown if you don't believe me.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I'm just going to focus on staying alive and finding a job and a new, secret apartment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just going to focus on staying alive and finding a job and a new, secret apartment.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I'm not sure what...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure what...

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: What are you implying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you implying?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way. I'm not the Aseptic though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way. I'm not the Aseptic though.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Silicon Weaving isn't like building anything else. It's closer to learning a musical instrument than working a hammer-drill. It's difficult to describe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Silicon Weaving isn't like building anything else. It's closer to learning a musical instrument than working a hammer-drill. It's difficult to describe.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I'll try my best. Maybe I need a hobby.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try my best. Maybe I need a hobby.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I survived the Aseptic, so I'll take my chances.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I survived the Aseptic, so I'll take my chances.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you believe what you want. I'm screwed either way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aren't you worried the Corpsters will come after you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aren't you worried the Corpsters will come after you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aren't you worried the Corpsters will come after you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aren't you worried the Corpsters will come after you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's one way of looking at it....

pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's one way of looking at it....
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's one way of looking at it....

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should hand yourself in?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should hand yourself in?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you should hand yourself in?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you should hand yourself in?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think you'll be able to do anything about Kikuchi and his chips?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think you'll be able to do anything about Kikuchi and his chips?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where were you last night?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where were you last night?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your skill set is interesting. Could you use that for something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your skill set is interesting. Could you use that for something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe find some way to take your mind off things?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe find some way to take your mind off things?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe find some way to take your mind off things?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe find some way to take your mind off things?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Engineering?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Engineering?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Killing maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Killing maybe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We live in dangerous times. We should assume everyone is capable of causing harm in the LUZ.
